description: A local or town organisation of the Slovak Anglers' Union (MO/MsO SRZ) by name: registered address, website, portal page and the fishing waters it manages (with ids for get_water). Personal contacts of officials are not provided.

lang.description: Language of the answer: texts and page URLs in this language. sk = Slovak (original), cs = Czech, en = English, de = German, pl = Polish, hu = Hungarian, uk = Ukrainian, es = Spanish, fr = French, ro = Romanian, it = Italian. Use the language of the user. If omitted, the language of the input is used when it can be recognised, otherwise Slovak.

name.description: Organisation or town name (town also in other languages), e.g. "Piešťany", "MO SRZ Žilina", "Bratislava 1", "Pressburg".

name: get_srz_organisation
title: Local SRZ organisation and its waters
